definitions.scope: Committed snapshot only; local edits and untracked files are not counted. Maintained production source is the headline; tests and vendored source are separate.
definitions.lines_of_code: Nonblank maintained production source lines, including comments.
definitions.lines_without_comment_only_lines: Maintained production source excluding blank and comment-only lines.
definitions.actual_loc: Maintained production source after recognized comments are stripped. Excludes docs, configuration, lockfiles, binaries, unsupported formats, generated code and fixtures; generated-header detection is heuristic.
definitions.comment_lines: Maintained production source lines containing recognized comments.
definitions.source_gb: Included maintained production source bytes divided by one billion.
definitions.configuration_files: Configuration paths counted from the tree without reading their contents.
definitions.google_mentions: Case-insensitive whole-word matches in maintained production source.
definitions.obsolete_functions: Heuristic declarations within six lines of obsolete/removal markers.

core_metrics.scope: Maintained implementation source in HEAD with local edits, deletions and non-ignored untracked files applied. Submodules and vendored sources are excluded.
core_metrics.method: Count nonblank lines after recognized comments are stripped; keep code beside trailing comments. C/C++ headers and FFI count. Remove Rust #[cfg(test)] and #[test] items. Lexical source inventory, not an AST or evaluated build graph.

exclusion_rules.other: Markdown/docs, configs, lockfiles, blank/comment-only lines, markup/styles, schemas/IDL, build scripts, generated files, fixtures, frozen net rewrite references and validation adapters; inherits classifier exclusions from .github/scripts/codebase_metrics.py

core_metrics.limitations: Includes unaccepted local Rust implementations. Path/header rules are heuristic; platform branches and embedded test code outside recognized Rust test items are not evaluated. Not a shipped-binary or migration-completion percentage.

accepted.meaning: Production-integrated feature slices implemented in this rewrite effort, not whole modules or a percentage of Chromium. Pre-existing unrelated Rust is not credited.
accepted.platform: Windows x64 out/Default; no cross-platform completion claim

local_rust_inventory.scope: net/**/*.rs and ui/base/resource/*.rs; includes tests, FFI and generated sources; excludes archives and build tree

limitations: Core implementation source counts include local edits and untracked rewrite files; source share is not migration completion.
The working tree is scanned file by file; this is a timestamped source snapshot, and concurrent rewrites can make it stale immediately.
Acceptance applies to archived Windows x64 source snapshots, not automatically to current mutable files.
Working source presence and archived native validation do not prove configured integration or acceptance.
Work reports are selected by run slug, never filesystem modification time; current work may be newer than those reports.
Full desktop shipped-dependency closure and cross-platform acceptance remain unverified.
